body.message:
Hi, I hope you’re well.

I’m getting in touch to enquire about your long-stay apartment options. I’m currently looking for accommodation for an extended stay and would appreciate some information regarding availability and long-stay rates.

My requirements are as follows:

Preferred dates: 6th January to 30th April 
Number of guests: 2
Apartment preference: 1-bedroom 
Could you please let me know what options you currently have available and the best long-stay rate you would be able to offer?

I’d also appreciate details on what is included in the rate, such as housekeeping, utilities, Wi-Fi and access to hotel facilities, as well as any deposit, payment terms and cancellation conditions.

If you have a brochure or details of the available apartments, please feel free to send those across as well.

Many thanks, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

Michelle.
